name: KIC 10318787
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 8.3 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.88 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,065 K at its surface.
